identity_master.prompt_summary: Master candidate nữ Cung Tu, mắt tím xám, tóc lam đậm tết lệch, pháp bào bạc trăng xanh mực, tạo bằng built-in image_gen, nền alpha, cung chỉ hiện ở concept master; không tuyên bố owner-approved.

animation_sheet_rules: 4 columns x 6 rows; each row is Idle, Walk, Attack, Cast, Hit, Downed; four visibly distinct adjacent full-body pose cels; direction genuinely redrawn, no flip; no held weapons or VFX; transparent background; fixed master identity.

front.prompt_summary: Use the exact identity master; create 24 full-body body-only cels in a 4x6 grid, facing front; preserve unique asymmetric design and continuity, no mirror, no rig, no held weapons or VFX.
front.postprocessing: Selected crop-safe variant and/or alpha cleanup are recorded in the clip manifest.

limitation: The candidate AI sheets were not corrected by neighboring-frame inpainting/onion-skin. No owner approval is implied. Weapon overlay/grip metadata is separate and remains pending.
